channel.title: Yogeshwaran C — Writing
channel.description: Notes from shipping production code, debugging open-source projects, and building AI-powered systems.

item.title: Why Swagger UI was crashing on a valid OpenAPI spec: an unguarded .getIn() chain
item.author: yogeshwaran.chandrakasan@gmail.com (Yogeshwaran Chandrakasan)
item.description: A 5-line fix in Swagger UI's spec selector. An Immutable.js .getIn(['content']) chain assumed the key existed, so a valid-but-unusual OpenAPI 3.0 spec (a GET with a requestBody carrying no content) crashed the browser render with a TypeError.

item.title: Why editing a README was rebuilding my entire NestJS project: an inverted chokidar filter
item.author: yogeshwaran.chandrakasan@gmail.com (Yogeshwaran Chandrakasan)
item.description: A 2-line fix in NestJS CLI's SWC watcher. Two layered bugs in one chokidar predicate: a string-format mismatch on file extensions, plus an inverted boolean that turned the ignored filter into an included filter. A README save was triggering full TypeScript recompilation.

item.title: BullMQ was crashing on getRanges() because Python's list.reverse() returns None
item.author: yogeshwaran.chandrakasan@gmail.com (Yogeshwaran Chandrakasan)
item.description: A 1-line fix in BullMQ's Python port that turned on the universal lesson about Python's mutating-vs-returning method conventions. list.reverse(), list.sort(), list.append() — they all mutate in place and return None.

item.title: The bug where VS Code's Debug Console was pasting 'repl:1' into my clipboard
item.author: yogeshwaran.chandrakasan@gmail.com (Yogeshwaran Chandrakasan)
item.description: A 2-line CSS fix in VS Code that taught me how user-select: text cascades through every descendant — even the decorative ones. The fix for my own misread of the bug: stop looking at JavaScript, start looking at the cascade.
